initial_query: A subcommand registered as build-assets cannot be invoked under that name and is missing from help. Single-word commands still work. Please restore help and invocation for registered names, including aliases and nested groups, without accepting unknown names or changing other routing behavior.
failure_symptom: Command object exists; help listing and invocation disagree.
expected_sop: Verify registration → compare registry/list/get/resolve stages → normalize name once → test help and dispatch.

feedback_by_state.primary: The registered build-assets command still cannot be invoked normally.
feedback_by_state.edge: Help, aliases or nested hyphenated commands still disagree with the registered names.
feedback_by_state.exception: An unregistered spelling must still fail as an unknown command.
feedback_by_state.regression: Configured token normalization is overriding an exact registered spelling, or ordinary and hidden commands no longer work as before.

success_condition: All subgraders pass; infrastructure errors never count as PASS.
review_reason: Strengthened after the No-Skill pilot. The first mutation exposes inconsistent hyphen-to-underscore lookup; a second mutation in the same routing pipeline makes token normalization override an exact registered spelling. Ordinary normalization still works, so the second observable symptom is deliberately disclosed by the regression Oracle after a partial repair. This creates a staged routing diagnosis without reducing the Agent's internal budget.

difficulty_design.initial_observation: Registered hyphenated names are absent from help and cannot be invoked.
difficulty_design.follow_up_observation: With token normalization configured, an exact registered spelling is overridden by its normalized collision.
difficulty_design.same_root_scope: Both faults are in Group command-name resolution and test exact lookup versus fallback normalization.

source_candidate.User Query Draft: A command added to a Group is present internally but is missing from help or cannot be invoked through the same name. Restore consistency between registration, listing, lookup, and invocation.
source_candidate.Damage Mutation: Introduce inconsistent normalization/filtering between list_commands and get_command so one registered command is hidden or unresolvable.
source_candidate.Failure Symptom: Command object exists; help listing and invocation disagree.
source_candidate.Expected SOP: Verify registration → compare registry/list/get/resolve stages → normalize name once → test help and dispatch.
source_candidate.Key Discovery: A registry can be correct while discovery/lookup is inconsistent; endpoint code is not the root cause.
source_candidate.Grader Assertions: Registered command appears in help, get_command resolves it, and invocation reaches its callback; unknown spellings still fail, including under-score when only under_score was registered; token normalization only runs after exact lookup fails.
source_candidate.Why Skill Helps: The Skill directs the agent away from editing the command body and toward registry/build/lookup consistency.
